title: Higher procyclic scalar primitives with complete coefficients
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime and let $F$ be a complete normed field with a normed $\mathbf Q_\ell$-algebra structure, so the scalar embedding is isometric [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]. Let $S$ be any profinite set in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], including the empty set. Use all continuous functions for the norm topology [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Write $H=\mathbf Z_\ell$ additively. For $r\geq0$ the trivial-action continuous cochain differential is
$$(df)(s;t_1,\ldots,t_{r+1})=f(s;t_2,\ldots,t_{r+1})+\sum_{i=1}^{r}(-1)^if(s;t_1,\ldots,t_i+t_{i+1},\ldots,t_{r+1})+(-1)^{r+1}f(s;t_1,\ldots,t_r).$$
For every $q\geq2$ and every $z\in C(S\times H^q,F)$ with $dz=0$, there exists $b\in C(S\times H^{q-1},F)$ with $db=z$. These are equalities of actual continuous functions, not of closures of images. No incomplete coefficient field is included in this assertion.

proof.text: The normed algebra F is ultrametric: apply IsUltrametricDist.of_normedAlgebra to Q_l. With V=C(S,F), completeness, its supremum norm and its normed scalar action are supplied by [lem-sfb-compact-function-space-complete]. The strong triangle inequality holds pointwise, hence for the supremum norm. The empty parameter gives V=0. Compact-open currying [lem-coef-compact-open-currying], with the factors switched, identifies parameterwise cochains with C(H^q,V), respecting all faces.

source.place: Paragraph (3), open direct image; agent-written scalar analytic argument extracted in lem-sfb-procyclic-scalar-cochain-evaluation.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-banach-translation-difference-split] to V. Put R=C(H,V). Constants and Delta are continuous equivariant coefficient maps; postcomposition gives maps of continuous-cochain complexes. Their composite is zero. Postcomposition with the continuous right inverse of Delta gives surjectivity degreewise. Evaluation at zero continuously identifies the kernel with V-valued cochains. Thus these are a degreewise short exact sequence of abstract Q_l-vector-space complexes.

source.place: Paragraph (3), open direct image; agent-written scalar analytic argument extracted in lem-sfb-procyclic-scalar-cochain-evaluation.

proof.text: The compact-open coinduced contraction [lem-sfb-compact-open-coinduced-contraction] makes the R-valued cochain homology zero in every positive degree. For q>=2, both outside terms of H^(q-1)(H,R) -> H^q(H,V) -> H^q(H,R) vanish. Exactness of [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-homology-long-exact] gives H^q(H,V)=0. By ordinary kernel/image homology, every closed cochain therefore has a preimage under d. The coordinate range conditions make the preimage an actual continuous cochain. Uncurrying gives b on S times H^(q-1).

lean.statement:
theorem complete_procyclic_scalar_primitives (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (F : Type u) [NormedField F] [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[ell] F] [CompleteSpace F]
    (S : Profinite.{v}) (n : ℕ) (z : C(S × (Fin (n + 2) → ℤ_[ell]), F))
    (hz : ∀ (s : S) (t : Fin (n + 3) → ℤ_[ell]),
      z (s, fun i ↦ t i.succ) +
        ∑ i : Fin (n + 3), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i.val + 1) •
          z (s, Fin.contractNth i (· + ·) t) = 0) :
    ∃ b : C(S × (Fin (n + 1) → ℤ_[ell]), F),
      ∀ (s : S) (t : Fin (n + 2) → ℤ_[ell]),
        b (s, fun i ↦ t i.succ) +
          ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i.val + 1) •
            b (s, Fin.contractNth i (· + ·) t) = z (s, t)
